item.text: [{"task_id":"f0afb749","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    blue = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    scale = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    dr = int(round(params['rule'][3]))","    dc = int(round(params['rule'][4]))","    if scale <= 0:","        return grid.copy()","    h, w = grid.shape","    marked = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=int)","    seeds = np.argwhere(grid != bg)","    for seed in seeds:","        r, c = int(seed[0]), int(seed[1])","        for t in range(h * w):","            marked[(r + t * dr) % h, (c + t * dc) % w] = blue","    out = np.full((h * scale, w * scale), bg, dtype=int)","    for r in range(h):","        for c in range(w):","            if grid[r, c] != bg:","                out[r * scale:(r + 1) * scale, c * scale:(c + 1) * scale] = grid[r, c]","            elif marked[r, c] == blue:","                for k in range(scale):","                    out[r * scale + (k * dr) % scale, c * scale + (k * dc) % scale] = blue","    return out"],"shapes":{"rule":[5]},"params":{"rule":[0,1,2,1,1]},"rationale":"Each nonzero cell activates its wrapping southeast diagonal. Enlarge every input cell to a 2×2 block: original colored cells become solid blocks, and activated empty cells contain a blue main diagonal."}]
